Chapter 423 - 423 Computer Experiment; Body Sensing Equipment!

Chapter 423 - 423 Computer Experiment; Body Sensing Equipment!

423 Computer Experiment; Body Sensing Equipment!

Hao Zhiwu had always had a dream.

That was to game with one of the top players—Dream Type, Aunt, Old Rate, and Meowgod.

However, Lin Fan had all four of them on his team!

How amazing was this?

After a while, Hao Zhiwu looked away and focused on the tablet again. He continued playing the game excitedly.

During this time, he did not forget to take out his phone and record a few videos of himself and the game as a memento.

…

Lin Fan did not care about Hao Zhiwu’s actions at all.

At this moment, he had already arrived at the entrance of Teaching Building No. 1.

The reason why Lin Fan was so eager to complete the mission was that he was in a hurry.

On the one hand, this mission could increase his computer science experience level.

On the other hand, he was also very interested in the gaming helmet that Hao Zhiwu mentioned.

As long as one put on the helmet, one could enter the game world. How fun would that be?

At this moment, a bald man in a white shirt walked over.

When he saw Lin Fan, his silver-rimmed glasses flashed as he quickly walked over.

“Hello, Professor Lin!” the bald man said happily. “I’m Qiu Junxiong, a professor at the School of Computer Science.”

Lin Fan’s name had long since spread throughout Jiangbei University.

Qiu Junxiong naturally recognized him.

“Oh, it’s Professor Qiu,” Lin Fan said. “Hello.”

Lin Fan greeted him!

The smile on Qiu Junxiong’s face widened as he continued, “Professor Lin, Professor Liu Wei and I have brought a few graduate students to carry out a sensory device experiment. Are you interested in taking a look?”

After he said this, a look of anticipation appeared on his face.

A long time ago, there was a saying circulating among the teachers of Jiangbei University.

If one wanted to make a breakthrough in their research, get Lin Fan to be interested!

Initially, Qiu Junxiong did not pay much attention to such words.

However, not long ago, Wang Jun and Chen Haiyang, who were professors at the School of Computer Science, had piqued Lin Fan’s interest in their experiments.

From there, he invented the carbon-based photolithographic machine and published a thesis on Science!

This matter made all the professors in the computer science department extremely jealous.

One had to know…

Wang Jun and Chen Haiyang were now often interviewed and reported about by various media outlets. They had become big names in the field of computer chips.

In addition, Jiangbei University had also increased its investment in all its projects.

It could be said that Wang Jun and Chen Haiyang were rich and famous now!

How could they not be jealous?

All of this was because of Lin Fan.

When Lin Fan heard Qiu Junxiong’s words, his heart skipped a beat.

An experiment on a sensory device?

Could this be considered related to his gaming helmet?

Even if there was no connection, as long as he watched the experiment, it would be enough!

Thinking of this, Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, let’s go take a look.”

He agreed!

Lin Fan agreed!

The joy in Qiu Junxiong’s heart grew even stronger.

He hurriedly said, “Professor Lin, this way, please.”

Under Qiu Junxiong’s lead, the two of them walked to the second floor.

Just as they left, Wang Jun happened to walk over.

Wang Jun happened to see the backs of Lin Fan and Qiu Junxiong going upstairs. He muttered, “Did Qiu Junxiong recruit another new student?”

Obviously, Wang Jun did not recognize Lin Fan.

…

Laboratory 203.

The two graduate students’ fingers quickly jumped on the keyboard.

The other two graduate students were adjusting the various circuits of the welding.

Professor Liu Wei, whose hair was slightly white, stared at the computer screen and was deep in thought.

At this moment, the laboratory door was pushed open.

Qiu Junxiong said excitedly, “Everyone, stop what you are doing for a while.”

When everyone heard this, they could not help but turn around and look over.

The graduate students were still confused.

Liu Wei’s expression changed suddenly, and he said excitedly, “Are you Professor Lin?”

One had to know…

Liu Wei was probably over 50 years old.

Even Lin Fan was not used to being addressed so respectfully by someone in his 50s.

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “I am Lin Fan. But you don’t have to be so polite.”

After getting Lin Fan’s approval, Liu Wei did not treat him as he was supposed to.

On the contrary, he became even more excited and respectful.

He took two steps forward and grabbed Lin Fan’s right hand, “Professor Lin, thank you for your invention of the carbon-based photolithographic machine. You’ve saved Hua Nation from being suppressed by others.”

Liu Wei’s tone was very sincere.

This was definitely from the bottom of his heart.

He had been in Hua Nation’s computer industry for more than ten years, and he knew very well how important chips were to the country.

Now, the problem had been resolved!

When Liu Wei learned that someone in Hua Nation had invented the carbon-based photolithographic machine, he was so happy that he almost cried.

Now, he had seen the inventor of the carbon-based photolithographic machine with his own eyes.

How could he not be excited?

Compared to Liu Wei’s excitement, the faces of the four graduate students were slowly filled with admiration.

Lin Fan could be said to be a god-like existence in Hua Nation’s computer science circle, especially in Jiangbei University’s computer science department.

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and looked at Liu Wei’s employee badge. “Professor Liu, I heard from Professor Qiu that you’re researching a sensory device?”

“We started researching it last year,” Liu Wei said truthfully. “At that time, we were actually hesitant. After all, even if the research was successful, we’d need a chip with excellent performance to operate it.

“But there’s no need to worry now! It’s all because of the carbon-based chip that you invented, Professor Lin!”

At this point, Liu Wei’s emotions, which had just calmed down, became excited again.

Lin Fan said, “I’m not sure about that. Can I take a look at your experiment?”

Liu Wei did not hesitate at all and said directly, “Of course!”

Lin Fan was now a god-like existence in the computer circle. To be able to do experiments in front of him was something that he could not be happier about. How could he reject Lin Fan’s request?

“Let’s do an experiment on the latest research. I’ll do it myself!” Qiu Junxiong said.

“I’ll do the data!” Liu Wei said.

The two professors took action personally.

It was obvious that they placed great importance on this experiment. They wanted to show Lin Fan the most perfect side of the experiment.

The strange-looking machine let out a low sound.

On the computer screen, many complicated patterns, codes, and data gradually appeared.

Although Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei were older and their movements were a little slow, their operations were stable!
